citations.assessment: The Rif’s witness reads ben Yosef. It corroborates the father’s given name and uses the Hebrew rather than Aramaic patronymic marker.
This Bavli witness has Sumkhos without a patronymic, then gives Rav Aḥa’s instruction concerning the dalet.
The checked Rosh reads ben Issi. Heilprin reports the same patronymic using bar and regards it as an error. Attribute the correction to Heilprin and retain the distinct witnesses.
The baraita names R. Abba as asking Sumkhos how to sell property inherited from his brother.
The cross-reference repeats the exact dialogue under Rav Abba. The Bavli gives R. Abba bare. The identification is Heilprin’s, not established by the bare name.
The named sage transmits Sumkhos’s rulings in both Bava Kamma witnesses. The internal biography lists the corresponding passage.
Natan asks what R. Yehoshua meant in the dispute over a captive wife, and Sumkhos says he did not hear the answer.
